name: Product Watch

sources.title: Pricing — Free (30-day queue or badge skip) vs Priority Pass vs Promoted (custom)

conditions: Free launch sits in a 30-day queue — OR embed the ProductWatch badge on your website to skip the queue AND get a featured spot on launch day
Free tier includes a permanent 72 DR do-follow backlink
requirements: Account sign-in required ('+ Submit your product' → sign in)
Product fits categories like AI, Productivity, SaaS, Web App, Developer Tools, Marketing, Design Tools, API
preparation: ProductWatch badge embedded if you want the free queue-skip + featured spot

Paid options: Priority Pass (price not shown in fetched text, '/launch' one-time) → instant go-live, top featured spot, 5-upvote head start, 2x upvote multiplier, newsletter features; Promoted = custom sponsored placement via email contact
workflow: Sign in, then open '+ Submit your product' (/product/create)
Free: wait 30 days in queue, or verify the badge to launch immediately with a featured spot
Priority Pass: pay once to go live instantly with the upvote multiplier and newsletter features
watchFor: Badge on free = queue skip AND featured spot — unusually strong free-tier perk if you accept the badge
Priority Pass grants a 5-upvote advantage and 2x multiplier — paid launches are structurally favoured in rankings
Priority Pass price was not rendered in the fetched page text
Daily/weekly/monthly 'Award Winners' leaderboards exist — ranking matters for extra visibility
countsAsLive: Product appears under /products/<slug> and in Launches (/launches/day) on its launch day with upvotes/comments active
unknowns: Whether badge-free free listings still get the dofollow link after the 30-day wait (page implies yes: 'Free … permanent 72 DR do-follow backlink')
